_comment: Bonakala - minimal Orthanc configuration (central archive). REFERENCE SKELETON to be completed during the build. Orthanc is GPLv3 and runs as a separate container reached over REST/DICOMweb only; see docs/17 section 13. Storage and index settings for PostgreSQL and S3 are supplied via ORTHANC__* environment variables in docker-compose.yml.
Name: BONAKALA-CENTRAL
_comment_tls: TLS is terminated by caddy/traefik in front of Orthanc; DICOM TLS from gateways is configured under DicomTlsEnabled once certificates are provisioned.

DicomModalities._comment: Edge Gateways and referrer PACS are registered here by the enrolment flow (M02/M21). Example entries only.

Worklists._comment: Modality Worklist SCP. On the central archive this is normally disabled (the Edge Gateway serves MWL); it is enabled here so the same file works for a single-site pilot without a gateway. The gateway service writes .wl files into the Database folder from the Platform worklist.

PostgreSQL._comment: Host, database and credentials are injected via ORTHANC__POSTGRESQL__* environment variables.

AwsS3Storage._comment: Object storage for pixel data (MinIO/SeaweedFS S3 API). Credentials and endpoint via ORTHANC__AWS_S3_STORAGE__* environment variables.

_comment_events: Study-stable and instance-received events are consumed by the Platform via the Orthanc REST changes API (polled by api/orthanc-bridge) and published as M09 domain events; no Lua hooks are required.
